shots.line: A quick update just came across the wire here in Helsinki, reported by FinSMEs.
We are heading over to Lapinlahdenkatu 16 to check in on Saidot.
According to FinSMEs, Saidot has raised a new funding round for an undisclosed amount.
Founded in 2018 by Meeri Haataja, Saidot builds an AI governance platform for enterprise AI agents.
Before this announcement, the team had raised 1.75 million euros in seed funding.
